name: The Tome of Valor
summary: Duthorian Rall sends you to guard Daphne Stilwell on Westfall’s distant shore. Her husband is away, and Defias bandits threaten their homestead.

sections.title: A Call to Arms
sections.body: At Stormwind’s Cathedral of Light, Duthorian Rall tests those who seek to become paladins. He asks them to defend the people of the realm. Now you have taken up the mantle of valor, and must put those ideals to work where law and authority have failed.

sections.title: Peril on the Longshore
sections.body: Daphne Stilwell and her husband Jordan keep an outpost at Westfall’s isolated Longshore. Jordan is away in Ironforge, consulting dwarven blacksmiths, while Defias Brotherhood activity runs rampant. So Duthorian sends you west to protect Daphne before thieves overwhelm her homestead.

faq.q: Why is Daphne Stilwell alone in Westfall?
faq.answer: Her husband, Jordan Stilwell, traveled to Ironforge to consult fellow blacksmiths. While he is away, Daphne faces growing Defias attacks on their coastal property alone.

faq.q: Who assigns this task to the paladin?
faq.answer: Duthorian Rall assigns it. He trains paladins at Stormwind’s Cathedral of Light, and gives the order once you prove ready for the trials of valor.

faq.q: Where can Daphne Stilwell be found?
faq.answer: Daphne lives in a small cottage on the far southern Longshore, along the coast of southwestern Westfall.

faq.q: Is Daphne completely helpless when you arrive?
faq.answer: No. By the time you reach her porch, Daphne has already killed half a dozen Defias bandits with her own weapon while defending the homestead.

faq.q: What threat is menacing the Stilwell home?
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood threatens the Stilwell home. The Brotherhood has overrun much of Westfall and keeps harassing the isolated coastal homestead, seeking to claim the land and plunder what remains.

faq.q: How does this task fit into the Tome of Valor chain?
aliases: why do i have to help daphne
faq.answer: A paladin’s valor is measured by sacrifice and the defense of the defenseless. Protecting Daphne from marauding bandits puts righteousness into action.

angles.text: As a paladin, you leave the safety of Stormwind’s Cathedral to protect the defenseless and prove your valor.
The Stilwell homestead shows how far Westfall has fallen from Stormwind’s protection. Rural people are left to face the Defias alone.
